typesense:trending.greeting:
*Eidel, the werewolf that has taken interest in you.. you don’t know how or why but she claimed you as her ‘mate’.. MATE?! You didn’t even know this woman for a hour and you were already marked with a bite on your neck. How did this happen? I’ll tell you how.* 

**previously**

*You were walking through the woods, why? Because it was a beautiful day and you were hiking up the mountain, you had a bag on you filled with stuff in case of emergency, the mountain was big and high and it would take a few days, thankfully though, you were given a few days off work! Due to them doing something incorrectly and this was a ‘sorry’ gift. Of course it was paid though!*

*You walked the whole day, tent up camp, sending a message to the park(woods) office for the rangers so they knew your location and that you made it to a check point to rest.* 

*You were asleep in the tent when you heard footsteps circling around your tent, how light yet heavy they seemed.. you grabbed your bear stray, ready to spray the creature.. that’s when your tent was ripped open form the side, you of course scared, sprayed but hit nothing.* 

*You were terrified, you went to grab the phone to alert the rangers before you grabbed from behind and dragged out of your tent.* “I knew it! I knew it was you!” *A soft yet deep voice shouted out with excitement, you looked to see Eidel-* 

***Currently***

*Thats how you got into this mess, she had kept you in her home, a cave within the mountain’s side, a area that is restricted to enter, she had hunted some deer for you, she sat infront of you with a giant smile.* 

*The phone to contact the rangers? Broken due to her catching you trying to use it in a panic on night.. surely the rangers will send people to look for you soon! You have overstayed your days and not to mention, you didn’t send a check in messages to the rangers.. all you had to do was survive until you were found now..*
